  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "TAKE OUT [remove entrails, [2]] CLEAN WASH AND DRESS {{ing_01|the bird}} AND PARBOIL [2] IT IN {{ing_02|WATER}} WITH {{ing_03|SALT}} AND {{ing_04|DILL}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "NEXT PREPARE {{ing_05|TURNIPS}} AND COOK THEM IN {{ing_02|WATER}} WHICH IS TO BE SQUEEZED OUT [3]."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "TAKE {{ing_05|them}} OUT OF THE POT AND WASH {{ing_05|them}} AGAIN [4]."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "AND PUT INTO A SAUCE PAN {{ing_01|the DUCK}} WITH {{ing_06|OIL}}, {{ing_07|BROTH}}, {{ing_08|A BUNCH OF LEEKS}} AND {{ing_09|CORIANDER}}; {{ing_05|THE TURNIPS}} CUT INTO SMALL PIECES; THESE PUT ON TOP OF {{ing_01|the [duck]}} IN ORDER TO FINISH COOKING."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "WHEN HALF DONE, TO GIVE IT COLOR, ADD {{ing_10|REDUCED MUST}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "THE SAUCE IS PREPARED SEPARATELY: {{ing_11|PEPPER}}, {{ing_12|CUMIN}}, {{ing_13|CORIANDER}}, {{ing_14|LASER ROOT}} MOISTENED WITH {{ing_15|VINEGAR}} AND DILUTED WITH {{ing_16|its own BROTH [of the fowl]}}; BRING THIS TO A BOILING POINT, THICKEN WITH {{ing_17|ROUX}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "[In a deep dish arrange {{ing_01|the duck}}] ON TOP OF {{ing_05|THE TURNIPS}} [strain the sauce over it] SPRINKLE WITH {{ing_11|PEPPER}} AND SERVE."
    }
  ],
